svg.text: Storage, one shared rail with two carriages, a wet cell (hob, thermo-cooker, oven), a dishwasher-tub well under the bench, a sliding hatch.
storage: option A +15 motors, option B +5
machine part A €7.29 k / B €5.60 k; appliances €3.24 k
shared beam: storage carriage + cell carriage
TOP VIEW (storage at module tops, cell at deck level)
front: OEM doors · human door · glass panels · hatch door
HOW A BOX TRAVELS, AND HOW THE DISHES COME BACK
Zoning: the two carriages overlap only over the box shelf (X 1880–2350);
the controller admits one at a time, a limit switch on each is the second channel.
Option A (compliant): S4 shuttle in the ambient column, robots inside fridge and freezer.
Option B (cheap): the storage carriage digs every store from the top through sub-lids.
After the meal: three well loads (cookware, rest, dishes); all clean ≈ 72–80 min.
Cell hand: X on the shared beam · Z on the hanging mast · Y arm · canned roll at the wrist.
Storage carriage: X on the same belt · hoist with passive toggle gripper on pick line y 290.
Each carriage has its own motor rolling on one static belt.

g.text: 1/9 Fridge top exit: the robot inside lifts the box to the window; the window opens 3.4 s; the storage carriage hoists the box into the gallery.
2/9 The storage carriage runs along the shared beam over all module tops to the cell port (≈ 4–6 s, no hand-over).
3/9 Lid station takes the lid off; the box goes down onto a stub carrier on the box shelf; the storage carriage leaves the shelf zone.
4/9 The cell hand (same beam) lifts the carrier with the box and tips the ingredients into the pan on the hob.
5/9 Carrier back to the shelf; hot sleeve rinse at the rinse cup; the pan fries on the 4-zone hob.
6/9 Plating: the hand pours the pan onto two plates on the bench; the storage carriage takes the empty box back to storage.
7/9 Hatch: the glass door slides left in front of the hob; the diner takes the two plates; the door closes.
8/9 After the meal: the hand sets a carrier on the bench; the door opens; the diner puts the dirty dishes in it.
9/9 Carrier parked on the cold hob, bench lid up, dishes into the well; lid down; wash with an 82 °C final rinse.
